nodes.name: Night City
metadata: Description: A free autonomous city-state located on the border between Northern and Southern California, known for extreme inequality, corporate control, and violence.
Atmosphere: Neon-lit dystopia with extreme wealth inequality
NotableFeatures: Corporate Plaza, The Badlands, Watson, Westbrook, City Center, Pacifica

nodes.name: Watson
metadata: Description: A densely populated district known for its deteriorating infrastructure and high crime rates.
NotableFeatures: Little China, Kabuki, Northside Industrial District

nodes.name: Westbrook
metadata: Description: An affluent district featuring luxurious apartments, high-end stores, and nightlife.
NotableFeatures: Japantown, Charter Hill, North Oak

nodes.name: Johnny Silverhand
metadata: Description: Born as Robert John Linder in 1988, Johnny Silverhand is a legendary rockerboy and anti-corporate revolutionary. Leader of the band Samurai and known for his silver cybernetic arm.
Background: Military veteran who fought in the Second Central American War before deserting and starting his music career.
Abilities: Musical Talent, Combat Training, Charismatic Leadership, Anti-Corporate Terrorism

nodes.name: Rogue Amendiares
metadata: Description: One of Night City's most powerful fixers and a legendary solo who once ran with Johnny Silverhand.
Background: Former solo who transitioned into becoming the queen of fixers in Night City.
Abilities: Combat Skills, Extensive Network, Strategic Planning

nodes.name: Arasaka Corporation
metadata: Description: A Japanese multinational security and defense corporation with enormous power in Night City.
Goals: Corporate dominance, technological monopoly, military superiority

nodes.name: Militech
metadata: Description: An American arms manufacturer and private military contractor, rival to Arasaka.
Goals: Military contracts, technological innovation, surpassing Arasaka
Leader: Various board members and executives

nodes.name: Tyger Claws
metadata: Description: A Japanese-influenced street gang that controls much of Japantown.
Goals: Territorial control, profit through illegal activities, cultural preservation

nodes.name: Samurai
metadata: Description: A legendary chrome rock band led by Johnny Silverhand that became symbols of the anti-corporate resistance.
Goals: Artistic expression, anti-corporate messaging, socio-political change

nodes.name: The Relic
metadata: Description: Experimental biochip containing the engram of Johnny Silverhand, developed by Arasaka.
Effects: Personality transfer, consciousness replacement, immortality potential

nodes.name: Malorian Arms 3516
metadata: Description: Johnny Silverhand's signature pistol, a custom Malorian Arms with unique modifications.
Effects: Devastating firepower, prestige, symbol of rebellion

nodes.name: Afterlife
metadata: Description: Legendary mercenary bar run by Rogue Amendiares, where the city's top solos gather.
NotableFeatures: Memorial wall, exclusive booths, high-end clientele

nodes.name: Trauma Team
metadata: Description: Subscription-based paramedical service that provides armed medical extraction and emergency services.
Goals: Profit from premium medical services, protect subscribers at all costs

nodes.name: Eurodollars
metadata: Description: The standard currency in Night City, commonly referred to as 'eddies'.

nodes.name: Johnny Silverhand's Porsche
metadata: Description: Johnny Silverhand's vintage 2013 Porsche 911 Turbo, one of the last gasoline-powered cars.
